name: Group Button
accessibility: Exposed as a group of real buttons with aria-pressed reflecting each segment's active state.
Visible focus ring per segment, independent of the active-state background fill.

source.notes: State, Appearance, Size and Corner radius are all captured as crossed properties (State, Appearance, Size, Corner radius) - every combination draws as its own Figma variant (including Full - Pill; large sets may exceed Figma's recommended variant count). Each segment's own label, Field label and Supporting text are bound Text properties (segments with Content="icon" have no visible text to bind); Show field label and Show supporting text are bound Boolean properties, with real geometry harvested by briefly showing them during export even if currently hidden. Content (icon placement) and segment count stay a page-level choice - changing the number of segments reshapes the component structurally, which Figma variants can't express without a separate master per count. The track and each non-icon-only segment hug their content in Figma (matching their CSS, which never sets a width); an icon-only segment keeps the fixed square width its Content setting renders at capture time. Native property IDs retain canonical values; anatomy styles and tokens use context.unit.
